# secopsctl curated

Google SecOps PREDEFINED detections: browse, search, and toggle Google-managed curated rule sets

## curated categories

Read-only: overview of curated rule-set categories with set and enabled counts

```text
secopsctl curated categories
```

## curated detections

Read-only: list detections a CURATED rule produced in a time window

```text
secopsctl curated detections <curated-rule-id> [flags]
```

```text
Detections from a Google-managed curated rule (aggregated across rule
versions). The `ur_…` id comes from `curated rules`. The user-rule twin is
`rules detections`.
```

**Flags**

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--hours` | int | 24 | look-back window in hours |
| `--limit` | int | 100 | max detections (page size) |
| `--state` | string | - | filter by alert state (e.g. ALERTING) |

## curated events

Read-only: the event(s) and rationale behind one CURATED detection

```text
secopsctl curated events <detection-id> [flags]
```

```text
Fetch the prioritized event(s), entities, and rationale behind a curated
detection (the id comes from `curated detections`). Human output shows the
rationale and counts; --json is the full payload. The user-rule twin is
`rules events`.
```

**Flags**

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--limit` | int | 0 | events per page (0 = server default) |

## curated rule

Read-only: view one curated rule's detail (metadata, MITRE, parent set, description)

```text
secopsctl curated rule <curated-rule-id>
```

```text
Show a single Google-managed curated rule: severity, type, precision, MITRE
tactics/techniques, parent rule set, and description. Curated rules are
Google-managed, so the YARA-L source is not exposed by the API — this is the
metadata the console's rule view shows. The id is a `ur_...` from `curated rules`.
```

## curated rule-sets

Read-only: list curated rule sets with deployment state (default: enabled only)

```text
secopsctl curated rule-sets [--all] [--category C] [--search Q] [flags]
```

```text
List the Google-managed curated rule sets with their deployment state
(enabled/alerting per precision). Default: shows only enabled (installed)
rule sets. Use --all to see the full catalog including disabled sets.

  curated rule-sets                          enabled sets (what you're running)
  curated rule-sets --all                    full catalog
  curated rule-sets --category cloud         sets in one category (name or id)
  curated rule-sets --search azure           text search on name/description
  curated rule-sets --all --search aws       search the full catalog

Use `curated rules --set <id>` to drill into a set's individual rules.
```

**Flags**

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--all` | bool | false | show all rule sets including disabled (default: enabled only) |
| `--category` | string | - | limit to one category (display name substring or UUID) |
| `--search` | string | - | case-insensitive substring match on set name or description |

## curated rules

Read-only: list curated rules in one rule set (or --all for everything)

```text
secopsctl curated rules --set <id> [--search Q] [--tactic T] [--severity S] [flags]
```

```text
List the individual Google-managed curated rules in a specific rule set.
--set is required (use the id from `curated rule-sets`). Pass --all to list
every curated rule across all sets. Filter further with --search (name/
description substring), --tactic (MITRE id like TA0005 or its name), or
--severity. `curated rule <id>` shows one rule's full detail.

Note: only ~20% of rule sets expose individual rules via the API — the rest
are opaque (Google-managed, toggled at the set level only).
```

**Flags**

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--all` | bool | false | list all curated rules across all sets (default: requires --set) |
| `--category` | string | - | only rules in this category id |
| `--search` | string | - | case-insensitive substring match on rule name or description |
| `--set` | string | - | only rules in this curated rule set (id from `curated rule-sets`) |
| `--severity` | string | - | only rules with this severity (e.g. High) |
| `--tactic` | string | - | only rules with this MITRE tactic (id like TA0005, or its name) |

## curated search

Read-only: search across curated rule sets AND individual rules

```text
secopsctl curated search <query> [--installed] [--tactic T] [--severity S] [flags]
```

```text
Unified search: matches <query> against rule-set names/descriptions AND
individual curated rule names/descriptions. Use --installed to restrict to
enabled (deployed) rule sets and their rules. Combine with --tactic (MITRE id
or name) and --severity to narrow further.

Structured filters work without a text query:
  curated search --tactic TA0005
  curated search --severity critical --installed
```

**Flags**

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--installed` | bool | false | restrict to enabled (deployed) rule sets and their rules |
| `--severity` | string | - | severity filter (e.g. High) — applies to rules only |
| `--tactic` | string | - | MITRE tactic id (e.g. TA0005) or name substring — applies to rules only |

## curated set

MUTATING (guarded): toggle a curated deployment's enabled/alerting

> Guarded mutation — dry-run by default; apply with `--yes`.

```text
secopsctl curated set --category C --ruleset R --precision precise|broad [--enabled[=bool]] [--alerting[=bool]] [flags]
```

```text
Toggle one Google-managed curated rule-set deployment, addressed by
--category / --ruleset / --precision (precise|broad). The toggles are
tri-state: a flag you omit is left unchanged; `--enabled` enables and
`--enabled=false` disables the deployment; `--alerting` / `--alerting=false`
controls alerting independently of enablement. Guarded: dry-run by default,
--yes to apply against the live tenant.
```

**Flags**

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--alerting` | bool | false | turn alerting on (--alerting=false off); independent of --enabled; omit to leave unchanged |
| `--category` | string | - | curated rule-set category id (required) |
| `--dry-run` | bool | false | preview only (default behavior) |
| `--enabled` | bool | false | enable the deployment (--enabled=false disables); omit to leave unchanged |
| `--precision` | string | - | precise\|broad (required) |
| `--ruleset` | string | - | curated rule-set id (required) |
| `--yes` | bool | false | apply for real / skip confirmation |

## curated trends

Read-only: per-curated-rule detection counts + last detection

```text
secopsctl curated trends (--rule ur_a,ur_b | --all) [flags]
```

```text
Detection counts (bucketed by day over the window) and the last-detection
timestamp per CURATED rule, noisiest first — the data behind `push curated`
enable/alerting decisions. --all sweeps every curated rule on the instance
(chunked requests). The user-rule twin is `rules trends`.
```

**Flags**

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--all` | bool | false | sweep every curated rule on the instance |
| `--hours` | int | 168 | look-back window in hours (default 7 days) |
| `--rule` | string | - | comma-separated curated rule ids (ur_…) |
